text:
I'm sorry, I couldn't make the poster yet. Your Magic Hour account turned down the request because it has no credits left. Nothing was made and nothing was charged.

This is the plan once you have credits:
- Poster: vertical (9:16), warm illustrated food stalls under string lights, with "Night Market", "Saturday 12 July", "6–10 pm", "Riverside Yard" and "Free entry". It costs about 5–10 credits on a free-plan model.
- Reel: 8 seconds, 480p, no sound. It uses the same artwork with gentle movement behind the text. It costs about 192 credits (24 credits per second).

Before the reel, keep in mind that AI video can warp lettering when the picture moves. To keep every word readable for all 8 seconds, I'd keep the text area still and animate only the lights and stalls. If any letters still warp, I'll tell you instead of handing it over.

Something I can do now at no cost: an 8-second reel with your five lines drawn exactly on a plain coloured background, such as a deep night blue. The text will be sharp, but the background won't have the illustration or any movement.

Do you want to add credits and go ahead with the full plan, or should I make the free text-only reel now?

I'd like to add credits and go ahead with the full plan, please, since I want the illustrated food stalls and string lights in both the poster and the reel. Keeping the text area still and only animating the lights and stalls sounds right to me. I'm also sharing both of these on social media, so it's good they're both vertical 9:16, and free-tier resolution is fine.
